npcs.name: Hallgerd Rindasdottir
npcs.idle: My husband Bard was bitten at the new moon. The full moon's in nine days.

npcs.name: Seithkona Ulfrun
npcs.idle: Wolfsbane and warder's blood. I've seen it work. Once.

npcs.name: Ranger Eyvor
npcs.idle: Sidhe in Skona. Sidhe! Three days' march from the jarl's hall.

quests.title: Moonbound
quests.offer:
My husband Bard was bitten by a werewolf at the new moon. When the moon's full, he'll change - and stay changed. He ran into the ravine so he wouldn't hurt me.

Seithkona [Ulfrun] knows a cure. One cure. Will you [help Bard]? Nine days. We have nine days.

topics.Ulfrun: The seithkona. She's just over there, by the fire. She's done this before.

quests.summary: Hallgerd's husband was bitten by a werewolf and fled into the ravine. A cure exists, if it can be made before the full moon.

steps.goal: Ask Seithkona Ulfrun about the cure
steps.say: Wolfsbane from the old grove the ra guard, west of here - that's the first part. And the blood of a werewolf warder, for the second. Mix them by moonlight and it's one dose. Only one. I'll not lie to you about that. Bring me the [wolfsbane] and the blood and I'll brew it.

steps.goal: Fight through the ra guarding the wolfsbane grove
Gather wolfsbane from the old grove
steps.text: Purple hoods, nodding in the ash. You gather an armful.

steps.goal: Take the blood of werewolf warders
steps.text: You fill Ulfrun's flask. On the last warder's belt: a child's wooden doll.

steps.goal: Find Bard at the were-hut in the south-west
steps.text: Bard is here. Half-changed: hair on his arms, teeth too long. And curled up beside him, asleep, a little girl with ears too pointed.

steps.say:
Hallgerd sent you. I knew she would.

That's Ylfa. They bit her a year ago. She's been living with them. She's eight. She found me the first night and stayed. She thinks I'm her father now. The pack's [coming] for her.

steps.text: The pack falls back into the ravine. Bard is bleeding, grinning, and still mostly himself.

stages.name: Keep Bard alive
stages.announce: Howls in the ravine. The pack knows you're here.
stages.thanks: I'm still me. For a few more days.

stages.name: Grimfang, Wolfaur Headsman
stages.announce: A huge wolfaur with an executioner's axe. 'The cub is the pack's. And so are you, bitten one.'

steps.say:
One dose. Ulfrun was clear.

I could [drink it], and go home to Hallgerd, and Ylfa goes back to the pack - or into the ravine alone. Or [Ylfa drinks it]. She's eight. She could go home - she has a mother in Skona, she told me. And I'd stay what I'm becoming.

You choose. I can't. Every time I try, I see her face.

options.say: ...Forgive me, little one. ...It's bitter. Gods, it's bitter. Take me home before I change my mind.
Yes. Here, little one. Drink. ...There. Take her home. Tell Hallgerd I love her. Tell her not to come looking at the full moon.

steps.say:
He's home. Cured. Ulfrun says it took.

He told me about the girl. He goes to the edge of the ravine at night and listens. He'll do that for the rest of his life, I think. But he's home.

You brought me a child, and not my husband.

Her mother came from Skona village this morning and fell on her knees in the mud. I watched. I couldn't hate either of them. On the full moon I'll go to the ravine's edge. He told me not to. I'm going anyway.

child.text: Take this. The girl made it for you.

quests.title: The Sidhe's Maps
quests.offer:
There are sidhe in Skona. A camp of them in the far west - Hibernian druids, three days from the jarl's hall. I sent my best scout, Thorvald, to watch them. That was a month ago.

He's sent no word. Either they caught him or he's found something worth the silence. Will you [find Thorvald]?
quests.summary: A Midgard scout sent to watch a sidhe camp in western Skona has sent no word in a month.

steps.goal: Head west through the timber-cat woods
steps.text: Big cats in the undergrowth. And on a tree, a ranger's mark, scratched fresh: Thorvald's sign.

clue.name: a scout's cloak, pinned with a Hibernian brooch

steps.text: Thorvald's cloak, folded, with a sidhe brooch pinned to it - a gift, not a trophy. The post hasn't been used in weeks. He's gone in.

steps.goal: Fight through the sidhe camp's outer guard
Find Thorvald in the sidhe camp
steps.say:
Gods, keep your voice down - you're from Eyvor? ...Listen.

I got in. I got close to one of their seers, Niamh. Close. She trusted me. She showed me their maps - every road from here to the jarl's hall, every ford, every weak wall. I have them. I was waiting for a chance to run. Then she - then I started to [care].

steps.goal: Fight the sidhe druid who comes for Thorvald
steps.text: The druid falls. Behind the tents, a woman in green stands very still, looking at Thorvald.

stages.name: Draoi Fionnbarr
stages.announce: A sidhe druid steps out of the trees, staff burning green. 'My sister trusted you, Northman. Give back what you stole.'

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the sidhe maps
steps.say:
That was her brother. And that's her, watching us.

The maps would save Midgard - with them the jarl knows every road Hibernia means to use. Eyvor will make me a hero. And Niamh will know what I was. [Take the maps].

Or I [give them back]. To her. I go home with nothing, and Eyvor knows I failed, and Niamh knows I chose her. I can't. You do it.

options.say: ...Then let's go. Don't look back at her. I'm not going to.
Then I'll walk them over to her myself. ... She took them. She didn't say anything. Let's go home.

steps.say:
The sidhe maps. All of them. The jarl will give Thorvald a hall for this.

He hasn't said a word since he got back. He sits looking west. Here - from the jarl's purse.

He gave them back. He had the maps of half Hibernia's war in his hands and he gave them back to a sidhe witch.

I should have him whipped. I won't. I've been in love too. Here - take something. Don't tell the jarl.
